gallery.text:
BREAKING:

@AnthropicAI just dropped Claude Fable 5.2. It’s a paradigm-shifting model if you have a project ambitious enough to give it.

We’ve been testing it at @every, and I’ve seen this crazy explosion of creativity on the team. People are making their own creative software, games for their kids, and documentaries instead of slide decks.

Here’s your day zero vibe check:

• Coding: @kieranklaassen built Everycut, a video editor with the features we use from Premiere, Descript, and other tools—all in one app, with an agent built in. The first version was live in 3 days, and we immediately used it for our internal show-and-tell. This feels like a new era of professionals building their own professional tools, tailored to exactly how they work.

• Games and design: @jackcheng gave it a photo of his toddler’s messy playroom. It turned the actual toys into a playable racing game, with fun details like a stray shoe as an obstacle and a sippy cup as a power-up.

• Knowledge work: @hammer_mt turned his research into a documentary. The model came up with interview questions, he answered them on camera, and it cut the footage together. He called this the most productive 3 weeks of his career.

• A different way of working: Give it a big job and leave it running overnight or over a weekend. But tell it what “done” means: Mike found it could finish the build, then spend another day or two testing. Set the goal, the budget, and how much checking you need before walking away.

• The catch: It’s slow and burns through tokens. Our early-access usage was free, and these projects would have been expensive at API rates. It’s 20% cheaper than Fable 5.1, but for everyday writing, emails, or quick back-and-forth coding, I’d usually reach for something else.

The clearest signal: When our early access ended, @TylerNishida stopped working on some projects until he could get this model back. He didn’t want to build them with anything else.

The best measure of a new model is whether it makes you try things you wouldn’t have tried before.

Fable 5.2 absolutely does that.

Here’s our full day-zero Vibe Check:

gallery.author: alliekmiller
gallery.title: 全國水質地圖
gallery.summary: 作者說用 Fable 5.2 做了一張全美水質地圖，問題是哪些美國大城市未來幾十年供水條件更好，並附模型生成的預告片。
caveats: 公開預覽幀是一塊綠階分區地圖，能看到 Kansas City、Columbia、Jefferson City 等地名。
作者用散文描述了問題和資料來源（EPA、USGS 等），沒有另附可逐字複製的 prompt 全文。排名是作者自述。
gallery.text:
🚨 BREAKING: Anthropic has released Claude Fable 5.2 

I tested the new model and had it build a nationwide water safety map for me.

My question was which big American cities are best set up for water in the next few decades. The #1 answer, according to the model it built out, is...

Indianapolis, Indiana.

From one prompt, it scoured federal data across the EPA, USGS, NOAA, FEMA, and the Census Bureau (more than 5 GB, including 15.5 million EPA violation records and 2 million PFAS test results). Then I had a dozen other AI agents check its work (which found some errors, like Alaska’s North Slope getting a high score because its temperature data was missing).

The final map rates 3,100 counties and more than 900 city areas on 17 measures. On an aggregate score between water supply, climate outlook, water quality, testing and oversight, and backup, Indianapolis scored the highest. Cleveland trails by about a tenth of a point, with Cincinnati, St. Louis, and Nashville right behind.
It is insane to me that I can have a research question in my head and get this level of insight hours later.

The new model also built out this trailer video below.

gallery.author: SelfHostedSI
gallery.title: WebGL 皮影式寶塔
gallery.summary: 作者說把最難的一則 prompt 交給剛發布的 Fable 5.2：不用函式庫、一次生成的 WebGL 場景，有寶塔、河、船、晝夜、雨和花瓣。

對照標籤和通過數來自作者的畫面，不是本庫復現。prompt 全文沒有貼出。
gallery.text:
Fable 5.2 dropped tonight, so it got the hardest prompt I had: a WebGL diorama from scratch. Pagoda by a winding river, a boat, day and night, rain, petals on the water. No libraries, one shot.

3 of 4 frontier models passed all 10 of my automated checks. GPT-6.1 Sol's never started, one shader bug.

So the checks aren't the difference anymore, the look is. Fable's water reflections won it for me. Next round gets harder.

context.summary: Vincent：中文長線摘要（1000 agents／費馬等官方亮點）
context.text:
Anthropic 正式发布 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Mythos 5.2！

这次升级有点猛，几个细节值得关注：

1. 1000 个 Agent，30 小时完成费马大定理的形式化证明。

Anthropic 称，1000 个 Fable 5.2 Agent 协同工作，只用了 30 小时就完成了费马大定理证明的形式化。此前的研究版本花了 11 天。

2. 从零打造一个操作系统。

Fable 5.2 协调 1000 多个子 Agent，连续工作 8 天，从空文件夹开始，最终做出了一个可以在笔记本电脑上启动的操作系统。

3. 编码能力进一步拉开差距。

在 FrontierCode 2.0 测试中，Fable 5.2 的 Xhigh 成绩达到 49.1%，超过 Opus 5.5 的 45.5% 和 GPT-6 Astra 的 42.8%。

4. 更快，而且更便宜。

相比 Fable 5.1，生成速度最高提升 30%。

API 价格也下调至：

- 输入：$8 / 百万 Token
- 输出：$40 / 百万 Token

另外还提供 Fast Mode，最高提速 2.5 倍。

5. Fable 和 Mythos 到底有什么区别？

两者实际上是同一个底层模型。Fable 配备更严格的网络安全和生物安全防护，面向普通用户；Mythos 则面向经过审核的网络安全和生命科学研究机构。

值得注意的是，Claude Fable 5.2 的 API 已经同步开放，模型 ID 为 claude-fable-5-2，Claude Platform、AWS、Google Cloud 和 Azure 均已支持。

这次 Anthropic 想展示的，显然不只是一个更聪明的聊天模型，而是一个能够协调大量 Agent，持续完成复杂工程、数学和科研任务的 AI。

context.text:
LETS GO: Anthropic just announced Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2. And its insane!

According to the company, both outperform Opus 5.5 in almost every capability it evaluated, including coding, reasoning and vision.

TL;DR:

- Up to 30% faster output than Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, with clearer communication.

- On FrontierCode 2.0, Fable 5.2 at High effort matched Opus 5.5 at Max effort for roughly half the cost per task. At Xhigh, it had the highest score among the released models Anthropic tested.

- 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents formalized the existing proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem in 30 hours, translating it into a form a computer can check. Opus 5.5 completed 26% in 18 hours with the same setup.

- Mythos 5.2 accurately modeled 28 of 34 tested capsids, the protein shells used to deliver gene therapies.

- Both models performed as well as or better than recent Claude models on most alignment measures and were tested by external evaluators before release.

Medium effort is the default in Claude apps and Claude Code.

context.text:
突发，Anthropic 凌晨 3 点正式发布 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Mythos 5.2！

刚刚看完官方公布的评测，这次升级确实有点猛。

首先是 Agentic Coding。
在 FrontierCode 2.0 上，Fable 5.2 拿到了 49.1%，相比上一代 Fable 5.1 的 32.4%，直接提升了 16.7 个百分点。
同时超过了 Opus 5.5 的 45.5%、GPT-6 Astra 的 42.8%，以及 Gemini 4 Carbon 的 41.1%。

更有意思的是，在 High effort 下，Fable 5.2 的成绩就已经达到 45.3%，基本追平 Opus 5.5 的最高成绩，但单任务成本只有后者的一半左右。

其他几个领域的提升也非常明显：

FrontierSWE v2：56.3% → 69.9%
科研 Agent：52.6% → 74.6%
机器人 RoboDojo：27.6% → 64.9%
复杂工作流 AutomationBench：31.4% → 51.4%

其中机器人能力的提升尤其夸张，得分已经达到上一代的 2.35 倍。

而且这次官方还公布了几个很有意思的实际案例⬇️
一个工程师让 Fable 5.2 从空文件夹开始，协调超过 1000 个 Agent，连续运行 8 天，最终开发出一套能够在笔记本电脑上启动的操作系统。
另一组 1000 个 Agent 则用了 30 个小时，完成了费马大定理证明的形式化工作。

甚至还有两个关于黑洞的理论物理开放问题，Anthropic 称已经由 Fable 5.2 完成求解（行吧哥….）

价格反而下降了 20%，现在是每百万输入 Token 8 美元、输出 Token 40 美元，生成速度相比上一代最高提升 30%。

没等来GPT-6.2倒是等来了Fable-5.2….
context.notes: 轉述官方數字；含 vs Mythos／Opus／GPT 對照敘述
